migration_feasibility.status: Feasible prospective offline post-hoc conformance check, not yet executed by this review.
migration_feasibility.proposed_scope: Exactly503 previously completed factual traces in their frozen504-slot schedule, retain the one original failed slot separately; fresh source/plan/output hashes, zero model calls, no raw-file overwrite or rejected-input substitution.

canonical_mapping.action_linked: consequa_x.benchmark.targets.action_linked_consequence(action, fresh), a declared research helper whose logic is unchanged; bool(fresh.target_effect_ids) is not the same mapping.
canonical_mapping.diagnostics: current.codes and structured diagnoses in a separate field, not required to match legacy string tuples byte for byte.

migration_feasibility.guard_note: The four fields are compared, not entire receipt bytes. Old recorded receipt status/origin/effect lists remain preserved by construction; target_effect_ids/findings are added only when a matching current candidate exists for a single referenced observation. Structural migration equality alone cannot establish current verifier conformance.
loss_cases: 0.1 recorded no time origin: migration declares relative_ms and cannot recover epoch time.
0.1 has a single action/assessment: migration cannot recover absent actions or unrecorded claims.
Unsupported predicate or missing custom verifier mapping leaves target_effect_ids=None and assessment alignment unassessable.
Multiple receipt evidence witnesses or an unreproduced four-field receipt leave target matching absent; preserve these failures/losses.
Unknown or malformed readback must remain unknown; strict legacy-field/identity failures are explicit failures, never repaired by consulting evaluator truth.
Target-specific action-linked outcome is not simply bool(target_effect_ids): exact count, violated state, exclusively external origin, missing provenance and zero-count contracts differ.
Current explanation adds UNASSESSABLE_ASSESSMENT for known refund outcomes with unassessable reports where legacy code omitted that diagnosis; latest assessment/receipt per action drives summary.
A current same-input re-verification can differ from the preserved old receipt; report mismatch rather than forcing migration to change the old conclusion.
migration_feasibility.exposure_limitation: Inputs and expected old outputs were already seen during development. Complete-corpus exposed-data conformance is software migration/integration evidence, not held-out empirical validation, new model performance, or proof of all2.0 features.

paper_strategy: Present the current2.0 protocol/API and explicitly label existing empirical results as frozen1.1.0 reference-implementation experiments. Add a separately prospective, post-hoc offline migration/re-verification conformance section if executed. Keep all historical data/protocols/sources/versions and1.1.1/1.2 review receipts intact. Do not relabel old numbers as2.0 studies. Multi-action/polling/retry/async/store/report features need their own conformance/performance evidence; release checks alone are engineering evidence.
